title: Jesus' Birth - Christmas
introduction: The message of Christmas is that God became human. The eternal Word took up residence among us. The prophets had predicted it for hundreds of years - a virgin would give birth to a son, and he would be called Immanuel, God with us.

sections.title: The Prophecies
sections.description: Jesus' birth was foretold by the prophets hundreds of years before it happened.

sections.title: The Annunciation
sections.description: The angel Gabriel came to Mary with the incredible message.

sections.title: Born in Bethlehem
sections.description: Jesus was born in a stable and laid in a manger.

sections.title: The Shepherds and Angels
sections.description: The angels proclaimed the good news to the shepherds in the fields.

sections.title: The Word Became Flesh
sections.description: John describes the mystery of Christmas - God became human.
